## Ctx.renderEditKeyboard() method

Edits only the inline keyboard using the page template.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderEditKeyboard(keyboardInline: IInlineKb | null | undefined, data: IData | null | undefined, AGBaseId: string, options?: IOptEditKeyboard | null): Promise<true | (grammy_types.Update.Edited & grammy_types.Message)>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;true \| (grammy\_types.Update.Edited &amp; grammy\_types.Message)&gt;

The edited message object.

## Remarks

Sent via `editMessageReplyMarkup` — never touches message text. When `keyboardInline` is null, the markup resolves from the `<g-keyboard>` block of the given `AGBaseId` itself (via `getGKeyboard` with `data` for dynamic labels), which is what makes `AGBaseId` meaningful here. No send-fallback (nothing new to send): failures are classified via `Ctx.classifySendError`<!-- -->, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, logged, rethrown.

  await this.renderEditKeyboard(null, undefined, `photo-card`)
}
